entries.title: Rakazo v0.15.0
entries.note: Security Changing an MCP server's URL no longer carries its stored bearer token, header values or an OAuth client that never signed in to the new address. Before, the connection check after saving sent the old token to the new URL. RAKAZO_NAV_LINKS also rejects links to the app's own routes written in other letter cases or percent-encoded, such as /API/me , matching how the bundled proxy routes them. Password managers no longer fill or save in the vault's login fields. The web server refuses to start when its build id is not a plain timestamp, so a malformed id cannot touch files outside the asset archive. Added Attach Word (.docx) and PowerPoint (.pptx) files to a chat, and bots can hand them back. Macro-enabled and legacy Office formats are still refused. A routine's owner can switch on Use my computer so scheduled runs, Run now and @mentions use the computer paired in the desktop app,

entries.title: Rakazo v0.14.0
entries.note: Security Auto Review knows when a recipient, site, payee or bank account appeared only in content the bot read, and asks before sending private data, granting access or paying that party. After a run reads outside content, it also checks shell commands, typing into pages, desktop input and opening new sites. Saving memory or skills, changing routines and rewriting instructions after outside content are checked against what the owner actually asked for ( approvals ). Only the person who made a routine can edit it, so an edit no longer makes the routine run with the editor's accounts. Restoring an archived bot or group turns back on only the restorer's own routines. Bot run prompts are encrypted at rest with the Space's keys, like chat messages. entries.title: Rakazo v0.13.0
entries.note: Security Approval settings now apply across routines, connected chat apps, and work influenced by outside content. Auto Review considers recent instructions from the owner, asks about new sites when a URL could disclose private information, and can use the deployment's included reviewer when the selected one is unavailable. Unattended approvals expire after 30 minutes. Explicit blocks and spending limits still apply ( approvals ). Creating event triggers or saving skills can require approval when outside content may have influenced the request. Remote secret stores clean up unused credentials after interrupted writes, replaced sign-ins, and deletion of accounts or workspaces with connected services. Locked down which credentials screenshot jobs receive, removed messaging addresses from invalid-address errors, and updated the inbound email authentication dependency. Billing expires checko

entries.title: Rakazo v0.12.0
entries.note: Security Cloud-agent tools enforce the bot's current integration assignments and allowed tools before using a connected account. Inbound email needs signed recipients before it can be treated as the owner's instructions; an SPF pass reported by a relay is no longer enough. Email routines can still accept signed mail as outside data ( inbound email ). Saving memory after reading outside content follows the run's approval mode and Always allow list, including after a run resumes ( approvals ). Spoken answers containing both yes and no cannot approve an action. A texted YES or NO applies only to a group invite or agent connection request delivered before the reply. Ambiguous checkout totals require manual payment, including when an approved action is checked again. Amounts such as $.99 are read as cents, and payment-method controls are excluded from purchase approval. Model connection error

entries.title: Rakazo v0.11.0
entries.note: Security Updated third-party dependencies with known vulnerabilities, including the HTTP client used by model, mail and scraping connections, the mail sender, and XML and Markdown parsers. The development launcher's database cleanup accepts only database names it generated and quotes them, so forged database metadata can no longer inject SQL or point the cleanup at another folder. This affects source checkouts only. Added On Apple silicon Macs running macOS 26 or newer, the desktop app's This computer runs without Docker. The app downloads what it needs the first time you pick it, and each bot's computer runs as its own small VM with a firewall that lets it reach the internet but not your Mac or local network. entries.title: Rakazo v0.10.0
entries.note: Security Updated the IP-address parser to fix a regular-expression denial of service affecting address parsing in rate limiting and proxy connections. Failed MCP responses now have a total size limit even when they use an event stream, preventing oversized error responses from being buffered without a bound. Added In the desktop app's This computer mode, bots can see and use Mac and Windows apps when Let bots use this computer is enabled. Screen access is limited to owner-started chats and asks for approval on the first use of each app in a Space ( computer ). See subscription allowances, reset times and remaining credits in the account menu and Settings > Usage, with the same breakdown on the mobile account screen. Voice connections can reuse a supported model sign-in for speech and transcription instead of requiring another key ( voice and calls ). Added another optional remote compute

entries.title: Rakazo v0.9.0
entries.note: Security Mobile discards sign-ins that finish after a server change, preventing the previous server's session credentials from reaching the new server. Offline sign-out now retries session revocation when connectivity returns; Android also suppresses bot notifications while signed out. On iOS, old notification previews can still appear until revocation reaches the server. Credentials passed in local MCP server launch arguments are hidden from tool output, errors and run history, including authorization flags, numeric secret values and passwords in URLs. Incus computers explicitly start as an unprivileged user, including custom images without a declared user. Remote command working directories stay within the bot workspace, and team-chat attachment names are sanitized before entering bot context. entries.title: Rakazo v0.8.0
entries.note: Added On iPhone and iPad, an image pasted into a chat's message field is added as an attachment, as on web. Text copied with it still goes into the field. This needs the new app build. On iPhone and iPad, Rakazo appears in the share sheet. Share a link, text, photos or files from any app, pick a bot, and it lands in that bot's message field as a draft. This needs the new app build. More keyboard shortcuts on web and desktop: start a group chat, connect apps, open the chat's details panel, jump to the message box and dictate. Cmd/Ctrl+/ lists every shortcut, as do Keyboard shortcuts in the command menu and Help in the desktop app. Cmd/Ctrl+F in the desktop app finds text in the open chat, highlighting every match and stepping through them. entries.title: Rakazo v0.7.0
entries.note: Security Updated Better Auth to 1.7.16 for its November security fixes. The most serious one was in mobile sign-in, where the authorization proxy could sign values it did not issue. The others fix OAuth sign-in treating an unverified provider email as verified, email codes whose attempt limit could be raced, email-change links that stayed valid after the address changed hands, and passkey checks that skipped origin and user verification. Signing out, signing in to another account, or switching server on mobile now stops read-aloud and clears the replies still waiting to be read. Before, the phone kept reading the previous account's bot replies over the sign-in screen. Disconnecting an MCP server's OAuth stays in effect even when a sign-in was still finishing, including the first sign-in to a server.
